units.source_text: 这突发的奇想，贸然闯来。

en.t: This sudden fanciful idea came barging in without warning.

units.source_text: 但是，花时间反复琢磨的计划，不一定都会顺利成功。

en.t: But plans that have been pondered over again and again at length do not necessarily all succeed smoothly.

units.source_text: 好容易摸索到的道理，只要没有意识到，连突然的闪现，也要花相应的本钱。

en.t: As long as one has not become conscious of a truth arrived at only after much groping, even a sudden flash of insight requires its corresponding cost.

units.source_text: 当然，比起蹩脚的随意摆弄来说，成功率应该是很高的。

en.t: Of course, compared with clumsy random tinkering, the success rate ought to be quite high.
